title: Kripal's levitation talk to Lockheed engineers
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Kripal's levitation talk to Lockheed engineers, about 2010s at Lockheed Skunk Works, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Rice University. On the Danny Jones podcast, he revealed that Charles Chase, director of Lockheed's revolutionary projects organization, once invited him to give a private talk to top engineers on one topic, levitation.

related.note: Kripal speaking on levitation or flying saints to a Lockheed revolutionary-technology head. This is the same subject as the story of the levitation talk to Lockheed engineers, but here it is a public MIT lecture the head attended, not a private talk he asked for.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, relays that Jeffrey Kripal, a scholar at Rice University, said on another podcast hosted by Danny Jones that Charles Chase, a director of advanced projects at Lockheed Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design arm of the aerospace company Lockheed, once invited him to give a private talk to top engineers. The topic, Kripal says, was levitation. Michels tells it because, if true, it would mean serious weapons engineers were curious about people said to float.
